welcome.headline: A softer place for your <1>music library</1>.
welcome.description: Shiranami plays the files you already own. Folders you point it at. Nothing streamed, nothing watched, nothing recommended over your shoulder.

language.label: Language
language.hint: You can change this any time in Settings · Appearance.

folders.headline: Your folders are the <1>catalog</1>.
folders.description: Drop in directories. Shiranami scans your files, reads the tags, lifts cover art, and quietly hands you back a real library. No upload, no account, no maybe-it-syncs.
folders.title: Music folders
folders.empty: No folders yet. Add one to start building your library.
folders.desktopOnly: Adding folders is available in the desktop app.
folders.doneHint: Nice. Your library is filling up. Add more or continue.

tools.headline: Pull tracks <1>straight in</1>.
tools.description: Shiranami can fetch and import from a link. It just needs two small helpers: yt-dlp to fetch, ffmpeg to convert. Skip this if you only play files you already have; you can grab them later in Settings · Downloads.
tools.title: Download helpers
tools.allSet: Both helpers are installed. You're ready to import.
tools.skipHint: Optional. Only needed for downloading and importing.
tools.desktopOnly: Downloading is available in the desktop app.

appearance.headline: The window dresses for your <1>mood</1>.
appearance.description: Pick a scene, then size it to your screen. Everything here is reversible from Settings · Appearance.
appearance.themeHint: Tap any scene · the rain stays.
appearance.reduceEffectsDesc: Lighter animations and blur for slower machines.

playback.headline: Set the <1>flow</1> of the room.
playback.description: A couple of touches for how music carries from one track to the next. Change any of it later in Settings · Playback.
playback.resumeDesc: Reopen to the song and spot you stopped at.
playback.crossfadeDesc: Blend the end of one song into the start of the next.
playback.discord: Show what I'm playing on Discord
playback.discordDesc: Your now-playing track appears on your Discord profile.

visualizer.headline: Give the sound a <1>shape</1>.
visualizer.description: An audio-reactive scene rides above your now-playing bar. Pick one you like, or none. Change it any time.
visualizer.title: Choose a visualizer

privacy.headline: Help fix what <1>breaks</1>.
privacy.description: Shiranami can send an automatic report when something crashes, so problems get fixed without you having to track down a log file. It's off until you turn it on, and you can change your mind any time in Settings · Privacy.
sent: A small sample of performance timings
notSent: No personal info or account data
privacy.toggleDesc: Anonymous. Default off. Change it any time.
privacy.perfDesc: Also samples performance timings to find slow spots. Sends a bit more than crash reports alone.
privacy.footnote: Your username is stripped from any file paths before a report ever leaves your machine.

summary.headline: Your room is <1>ready</1>.
summary.description: Here's what you chose. Tweak any of it later from Settings.
summary.intro: A quick recap before the library opens.
